migration.name: 20261006120000_mcp_server_tool_policy
migration.backfill: Inline and fail-closed: every existing row lands quarantined via the column default; only the six bundled browser-use tools (server slug mcp-browser-use, exact tool names mapped in TOOL_TO_GRANTS) become approved. isEnabled is untouched. Guarded (IF NOT EXISTS / duplicate_object) and re-runnable; a re-run never changes a row an operator already decided. Verified by packages/db/src/mcp-server-tool-policy-migration.test.ts (shape always; empty, populated, disabled, renamed, annotation-bearing and re-run cases against Postgres when DATABASE_URL is set).
migration.rollback: Forward-only. Older code ignores the new columns and would list tools permissively again, so rollback means reverting the code, never dropping the columns.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Existing model; new policy columns follow the row's lifecycle and add no retention obligation.
